newsitem.title: CHINA: Price earnings ratios surge on China stock markets.
newsitem.headline: Price earnings ratios surge on China stock markets.

text.p: The average price earnings ratio of China's listed companies has risen sharply over the past year, with the Shanghai average now at 51.62 and Shenzhen at 47.71, the Shanghai Securities news said on Wednesday.
The newspaper warned that the figures represented increasing risk and called on investors to take note.

The average weighted price earnings ratio for 312 companies listing on the Shanghai Stock Exchange, based on 1996 results, is currently 51.62, up from 23.76 at the same time last year, the newspaper said.
The figure for 283 Shenzhen listed companies is 47.71, up from 18.20 this time last year, it said.
China's official financial newspapers have published several articles warning investors of risks on the stock markets following a strong rise in prices over the past few months.
